description: Immutable id registry. Each built-in entry received a permanent id when v2 content was created. Never regenerate or edit ids; new entries get new ids. legacyKey = mainKey::word (not unique).
algorithm: 'dv_' + sha256('deutsch-vokabular/word/v1|' + baselineIndex + '|' + legacyKey).hex.slice(0, 10) — applied once at minting
